The Story

Screen presence with range

Yousra Zeb Khan is a Pakistani actress and model who began her professional career in 2015. She quickly gained recognition for her screen presence and versatility, working across television dramas, modeling and commercial projects.

Between 2017 and 2021 she took a professional break while living in the United Kingdom, staying connected to the creative and fashion industry. She officially resumed her acting and modeling career in late 2021, returning with renewed focus and a diverse range of projects.

Since her comeback she has appeared in lead, second lead and supporting roles across major Pakistani television networks and digital platforms — while expanding into web series, films, short films, music videos, fashion shows and brand campaigns.
